name: Live Reaction
look: A news-style graphic: a red banner across the top with white block letters, "LIVE" at the left and "REACTION" at the right with a gap between them, above a large empty black box.
use: Frames a picture as breaking footage of someone's reaction. The gap in the banner gets a name, so it reads "live [name] reaction", and the black box gets a picture of that character or person looking shocked, smug or confused.
slots: who is reacting, in the gap between LIVE and REACTION (red banner)
examples: a photo of a cat staring in horror at a cucumber
describe: red banner that says live reaction above a black box
breaking news style frame with a red bar and a black screen
template with a blank black screen under a red title bar
tv news bar for posting someone's reaction picture
red and black graphic for showing how someone reacted
